about_the_game:
As a child, you witnessed the tragic fall of your noble house. It left you with many burning questions about the atrocity that transpired. Seeking answers, you arrive at the royal palace as the governess to the young princess of the empire.

Soon, you realize that under the glittering chandeliers and behind excessive decadence, the palace is not as perfect as it seems. 

When the young princess suddenly becomes ill, you have no choice but to seek one of the two princes for help.

Maximilian Windrake: A soldier of few words but unwavering strength, cold and collected. He is revered, almost feared, by both friends and foes. It might be difficult to work with him.

But is he worth the challenge?

Lucian Windrake: A charmer who draws people to him like a moth to a flame, warm and captivating. But there is hidden depth beneath the surface that you can't quite fathom.

Do you dare to peer behind his mask?

As you draw closer and closer to the revelation. You realize that maybe, just maybe, some truths might be best hidden.

Will you be able to survive the consequences that follow? Or will it consume you and the ones you love?

Play the DEMO to start your journey.

🌸 Demo: Features 12,000 words (~10% of the full game) and covers the common route, setting up the world and characters before the major romance branches.

👑 Two Unique Routes: Each prince is fighting their demons, waiting for someone to see them for who they truly are.

🔥 Passionate and spicy scenes: Toggleable according to preference

🎭 Expressive, Animated Characters: All the characters are animated and express a wide range of emotions.

🎨 Hand-Drawn and Animated CGs: Beautiful artwork illuminates key moments and truly brings the story to life.

short_description: Looking for steamy romances with brooding and enigmatic princes? Step into Fate’s Masquerade, where danger meets desire. Unravel secrets, navigate court politics, and make choices that shape your destiny. Along the way, surrender to love so powerful it will change the fate of an empire.
